scope: Canonical A/B architecture, including training-only diagnostics and the separately retained latest_model bundle. Paths are source citations, not runtime imports or downloadable artifact URLs.

tracking_contract.scalars: manifest.metrics plus metric_dimensions, preserving quantity/statistic and producing checkpoint/step/window/head/mode/unit; aggregate, paired and omission means, intervals, tail summaries and counts are all retained
tracking_contract.tables_arrays: manifest.artifacts with kind, relative path, SHA-256 and sensitive flag; original evidence and computed summary retained; any private or unknown record withholds the whole report remotely
tracking_contract.figures: manifest.panels and manifest.artifacts; checkpoint/step-scoped report directory
tracking_contract.missing_failures: manifest.statuses; unavailable is not zero or success, scoring/render errors fail strict reports
tracking_contract.transport: training.tracking.MlflowTrainingObserver.on_diagnostic consumes the same local manifest; no recomputation

evidence_contracts.conditional: inference.result.DecompositionResult: one separately sampled context/query marginal, paired sample axis for quantities and complete graphs, original entity names, masks, natural units and provenance
evidence_contracts.comparison: diagnostics.comparisons.ComparisonRecord wraps the public result with required kind=model/reference; generating truth/live support, graph truth and latent-total truth are separate optional evidence. Public data_sha256 identifies observed inputs, never generating truth.
evidence_contracts.omission: matched_omission requires identical original observed/noise/native_inputs/native_truth/time arrays, native input_names and truth_names bound to actual component IDs and stored per-window truth, exact visible active IDs after one declared removal, and matched checkpoint/settings/window/units. Family aggregate CSV differences alone are insufficient.
evidence_contracts.replication: load_replication_summary verifies an externally pinned version-2 derived-summary SHA, every raw archive receipt, required matched-omission and sparse-world archive membership, metrics/manifest hashes, and the source raw-score/pairing receipt. The verified scalar CSV also supplies context recovery, modal/per-family structure, absorbed mass, live-family errors and world-paired oracle gaps; additional scalar intervals bootstrap worlds using the recorded settings. Retained window-mean draws and weekly quantiles never become fabricated weekly joint paths.
evidence_contracts.reference: reference_diagnostics accepts aligned saved components/names/time/window/units/data identity and fit-health records; reference_fit_health requires divergences, R-hat, bulk/tail ESS, tree-depth hits and BFMI. Missing/nonfinite diagnostics remain unknown.
evidence_contracts.posterior_sbc: posterior_sbc_from_draws accepts posterior-world values and augmented-posterior draws for independent replications with observed-data hash, joint-draw declaration and valid sequential-continuation/exchangeable replicate contract. No replicate generation or posterior refit occurs while reporting.
evidence_contracts.c2st: run_c2st fits only an explicit diagnostic classifier to saved reference/approximate vectors, splitting whole world pairs. c2st_from_predictions scores persisted held-out probabilities without fitting. Paired label-swap null requires independent worlds and exchangeability within pairs. Unlike the source, correlated pair rows are not declared iid Bernoulli trials.

capabilities.applicability: Conditional samples only. Source context_from_world sampled the joint contribution head and separately collected auxiliary logits; that execution boundary is replaced, not relabeled. Explicitly supplied joint/auxiliary records retain their own head labels.
All expected panels; explicit missing prerequisites, finite/null metrics and strict failures; render saved evidence only.
Observed-only supported; latent total is distinguished from noisy observations and no predictive-noise samples are invented.
Active original channel IDs; truth optional; independent router/auxiliary labels not combined.
Average weeks within each aligned draw, not independent marginal draws.
Intrinsic baseline, latent/confounder total, control total and indirect total, with masks and native units.
Separate cc/zc/dc component identities when present; absence is explicit rather than imputed zero truth.
All present controls, including truly inactive observed inputs; padded slots excluded.
Generating truth required. Native scores and outcome-scale-normalized scores remain labeled; width, CRPS, coverage, signed/absolute error, negative/zero mass are distinct.
Router complete-graph marginals distinct from auxiliary structure-head probabilities; graph truth optional.
Same node/edge evidence rendered with native matplotlib rather than mandatory Graphviz; thresholded marginals labeled as such, not the posterior modal full graph.
Whole-graph frequencies, ties, mode and truth frequency from complete aligned graph draws. Never reconstructed from independent edge marginals.
Draw cardinality, forbidden families, off-prior mass and padding; explicit prior specification separate from optional generating graph truth. Missing prior makes its tests unavailable, not passed.

Exact supplied marginals produce explicitly factorized/cardinality-constrained approximations, not empirical full-graph probabilities or routing. Historical four-decimal probability-bank reconstruction is excluded separately; no fabricated exact counts from rounded records.

Population-ddof finite-draw within/between variance and covariance closure; exact graph/quantity alignment, singleton/rare counts, explicit limited precision. Not a calibrated conditional-law assertion.
Exact zero path mass separate from window-mean zero/cancellation. False exclusions require generating-live support; near-zero values are not structural atoms.
Inclusive discrete randomized zero ties; masks; dependent component-week populations labeled screening, never independent-world SBC proof.
Saved independent-world rank/draw populations with explicit scope and standalone rank/ECDF/coverage report cards; actual calibration evidence is separate from one-world screening.

Saved posterior-world/augmented-posterior evidence and valid replicate contract required. Marginal histogram adapters and generic exchangeable task appenders are not used for the canonical sequential model.

Saved reference/approximate world vectors; optional data features; MLP/logistic/quadratic classifiers; whole-world train/test split and saved held-out predictions. Paired-exchangeability p-value qualification documented, no resampling on replot.
Unhealthy and missing-diagnostic fits remain in comparisons, with R-hat/ESS/divergences/tree-depth/BFMI warnings. Fit health does not remove information advantages or misspecification.

Complete recorded loss tree: joint, graph-conditional, context, auxiliary structure, reconstruction, energy/variance terms where active, weights/UW and objective provenance. Inactive or unavailable terms are not invented.

All recorded learning rates, gradient norms/nonfinite health, parameter-group updates, semantic loss leaves, masks/weights and step/checkpoint identity retained. Historical gate authorization itself is excluded separately.
Every recorded numeric leaf/null and its producing step/checkpoint/head/mode retained; headline plot selection does not drop nonheadline evidence.

Across-world saved context-outcome mean/std scatter and both marginal histograms preserve the original corpus descriptor figure. Separately, within-world raw-input context/query means/scales/ranges preserve shifts. World identities, counts and provenance retained; no task generator runs during plotting.
Verified saved raw mean/scale interventions, original IDs and provenance; not execution of the historical generator/training arms.
Saved model_average/map/fixed views with matched data and checkpoint. Empirical full-graph mode is not edge rounding; fixed supplied graph is not given posterior mass.
CRPS of live-component window means and full latent total, scaled by recorded context outcome ruler; oracle gaps are paired within world, not unpaired mean differences.
Live-channel/control central 80% window-mean coverage with nominal reference, not a target of 100%.
Graph-average minus modal-graph paired CRPS; source negative sign favors averaging, not reversed silently.

Original retained live input IDs, identical original world data and true effects, equal scale, before/after per-component CRPS, average components within each world then bootstrap worlds. Aggregate-only reconstruction is rejected.
Exactly five generating-live controls, not five merely present inputs; false-zero path mass >0.5 and empirical modal complete-graph count hit are distinct quantities.
Strict all-live recovery and component hit rate both retained. The source's 0.8**k conjunction reference requires independence and is not promoted as a universal calibration baseline.
Median and p90 across worlds, not posterior quantiles. Source per-statistic bootstrap intervals retained in source_summary.
Truly inactive, present inputs; absolute attributed mean/outcome scale; explicit 0.01 threshold; component and world rates, mean/max attribution and mirror false-exclusions retained.
Paired B-minus-A CRPS, world-bootstrap intervals, wins/losses/ties; corpus/checkpoint profiles of one architecture, not architecture effects.
Full router mode exact match and per-family modal live-count recovery remain separate; reference methods without router have no invented graph posterior.

Native latent-total truth includes the hidden effect; visible component truths do not. Zero hidden mean makes absorption undefined. Source family signed errors sum generating-live contributions; all-active totals are separately named and never silently substituted.
Banked heldout records are labeled by original joint/auxiliary source and approximation. Every non-plotted scalar remains in numeric evidence; no claimed conditional equivalence.
Original scope/draw count/family provenance retained; no independent-SBC proof from pooled dependent week ranks.
Source scalar values retained, with no assertion that variance ratio 1 or correlation 0 is a generally correct Bayesian target.

Separate context/query marginal draws, generating truth and privileged approximate reference. Legacy inpainting/final-only gating interventions excluded from canonical inference; saved outputs retain diagnostic labels.
Predesignated smooth world, full saved natural-unit draws, context/query boundary, separate latent total and observations; flat-reference misspecification visible.
Predesignated five-control world; posterior mean/equal-tailed interval/zero atoms and saved truth; no near-zero coercion and no fit health suppression.

notebook_panel_expansion.interval_note: The original notebook uses shortest-contiguous 80% HDIs, the frozen whitepaper uses equal-tailed 80% linear quantiles. New reports explicitly state their equal-tailed definition; they do not call these HDIs. Zero atoms and whole-draw window means retained.

historical_exclusions.reason: Historical four-decimal marginal bank repair depends on a source-specific draw-count lattice and rounding ambiguity. Exact marginal/cardinality/set-reliability capability is retained; those rounded records remain original recorded evidence rather than silently invented exact graph counts.

Backbone/histogram-head and historical Task factory adapters do not implement the canonical graph-conditional architecture. Rank/PIT/report-card numerical capabilities retained through explicit saved-evidence contracts, without this runtime adapter.

Independent histogram-query sampling and blind append-to-context task mutation are not valid sequential conditional-model evidence. Saved joint replication arrays with an explicit valid augmentation contract replace this orchestration; posterior-SBC ranking capability is retained.

Issue-034 HMAC-authorized tiny-screen/production-canary process isolation, role-diet selection and promotion decisions are historical research execution infrastructure, not A/B model diagnostics. Objective/gradient/trajectory primitives and provenance preservation are retained in training records; their historical acceptance thresholds are not promoted as scientific release claims.

Closed-form binary-mixture Euler/velocity support experiments and bounded optimization probes investigate alternative synthetic representation instruments, not saved canonical A/B outputs. No additional sampler or optimization experiment is run by the release diagnostic suite.

These fit new post-hoc calibration maps to modify scientific routing, explicitly outside the issue's non-goal of repairing routing/calibration. Raw AUROC/ECE/probability/atom and degeneracy evidence is retained; no recalibrated performance is falsely attributed to the port.

Legacy context interventions and inline NUTS execution are not a trained canonical conditional posterior. Saved reference draws, health warnings, per-window recovery and width-ratio diagnostics are retained without rerunning them.

Static explanatory network/generator diagrams are paper illustrations, not diagnostic panels. Their numeric prior/input/architecture facts are inventoried under corpus-input-support and provenance; no private template/font pipeline is required.

Paper pagination, branded font/layout audits, private cache discovery and redundant file copying are build machinery. Public renderers retain evidence-derived labels and figures using matplotlib, and portable reports retain hashes without private source paths or trace fitting.

Generator, model inference, MCMC fitting and remote orchestration belong before saved-evidence diagnostics. Their actual world/draw/health/checkpoint contracts are retained; render/report functions never execute these producers.

artifact_availability.immutable_remote_references: Not provided by the frozen source bundle; Stage 1 publication/retrieval remains a prerequisite. Local absolute paths and observed hashes are delivered separately, not embedded as fictitious web links.
required_for_world_figures: mcmc_health.csv and parameter-level/receipt evidence, or verified compact whitepaper world evidence
